newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to sell 21 to 23 bln Ffr of OATs Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: France to sell 21 to 23 bln Ffr of OATs Wednesday.

text.p: France is to offer between 21 and 23 billion francs of government bonds (OATs) at its next scheduled auction on April 30, the Treasury said on Monday.
The Treasury will offer the current 10-year benchmark OAT, the 5.50 percent April 25, 2007 OAT, the 6.50 January 25, percent 2011 OAT and the 2009 TEC 10 variable rate OAT.
All three lines had a payment date of May 26.
The auction is taking place on Wednesday, rather than Thursday, because of a French public holiday on May 1.
